request.text: wardog's elevated shell on WORKSTATION5 used bitsadmin to pull a script from GitHub into the user's Temp folder. Disable account wardog.

package.rationale: wardog's high-integrity cmd.exe (PID 10044) started bitsadmin /transfer (PID 9260) to fetch a file from raw.githubusercontent.com into C:\Users\wardog\AppData\Local\Temp as bitsadmin1_flag.ps1; the BITS service then connected out to 151.101.208.133:443 and wrote BIT9584.tmp into that folder. BITS is being abused to download a payload; disable wardog.
